verdict.rationale: The Core API exposes JSON endpoints to list DNS records and domains (open format, machine-readable), which an AI-native user could use to pull their own data programmatically, but there is no dedicated 'export all account data' feature, no documented transfer-out flow, and no explicit data-portability statement — only transfer-in is documented. Missing for 10: comprehensive account/data export tool, documented transfer-out (leave) process, explicit open-format export guarantee, independent confirmation.
